edits.old: Judge meaning, not word count or grammatical completeness.
edits.new:
When a part lists or credits several subjects or kinds of creator, distinguish the meaning about this node from separately meaningful references to the others. A list, attribution or greeting does not make all of its meaning concern every named subject. Do not divide synonymous names or a restatement of the same meaning into separate subjects. Do not infer the content of a URL or an unseen attachment.

Judge meaning, not word count or grammatical completeness.
